purpose: Build an auditable Seurat object from aligned counts and sample metadata.
inputs: RDS list(counts: nonnegative gene × barcode matrix, metadata: barcode-indexed data.frame).
limits: Barcode calling on raw droplets is a separate upstream decision. Do not invent symbols or collapse duplicated IDs silently.
alternatives: Read10X/Read10X_h5 for supported 10x files; SingleCellExperiment for Bioconductor workflows.

purpose: Inspect mitochondrial/ribosomal, feature and UMI metrics and record cell retention.
inputs: Seurat object with RNA counts; explicit species-sensitive patterns and numeric threshold bounds.
outputs: QC-marked or explicitly filtered Seurat object
limits: A universal mitochondrial cutoff can remove meaningful injury states. Inspect each capture and tissue; QC does not detect all doublets or ambient RNA.
alternatives: scater robust outlier QC; EmptyDrops for calling cells in raw droplets.

purpose: Flag likely doublets within independent droplet captures.
inputs: Seurat RNA counts with capture/library identifiers (not automatically donor labels).
limits: Doublet rate depends on technology and recovered cells. Homotypic doublets remain difficult; retain audits before removing flagged cells.
alternatives: DoubletFinder; Scrublet in Python. Compare on the same capture.

purpose: Estimate and reduce ambient RNA separately by capture.
inputs: list(counts, aligned metadata, backgrounds = capture-named empty-droplet matrices); background can be absent.
limits: Background feature IDs must exactly match cell counts. Do not use already normalized counts; compare marker specificity and retained biology before adoption.
alternatives: SoupX when raw/filtered droplets and cluster information are available.

purpose: Library-size normalize RNA counts for exploratory expression and downstream geometry.
inputs: Seurat RNA counts.
outputs: RNA data layer with log-normalized expression
limits: Normalization does not remove batch effects. Keep raw counts for count models; do not treat data-layer values as integer pseudobulk.
alternatives: SCTransform for model-based variance stabilization.

purpose: Model count-depth effects and stabilize variance.
inputs: Seurat RNA counts.
limits: Regression covariates need biological justification. Preserve RNA for communication; sparse tiny demos may not exercise model fitting reliably.
alternatives: LogNormalize; appropriate count-based models for inference.

purpose: Align a PCA embedding across measured technical batches.
inputs: Normalized Seurat with PCA and explicit batch column.
limits: Cannot recover treatment effects perfectly confounded with batch. Harmony corrects an embedding, not raw counts; evaluate mixing and lineage preservation.
alternatives: Seurat anchors; unintegrated analysis when batch biology cannot be separated.

purpose: Build a shared geometry with Seurat anchor integration.
inputs: Seurat with RNA and explicit batch IDs; sufficiently populated batches.
limits: Baseline uses the stable anchor interface, not an asserted default v5 layer workflow. Avoid integrated values for DEG/CellChat; compare mixing and overcorrection.
alternatives: Harmony; Seurat v5 IntegrateLayers after separate version-specific validation.

purpose: Find variable features, PCA, neighbors, clusters and reproducible UMAP.
inputs: Normalized Seurat object.
limits: Resolution is a biological decision, not a cell-type count estimator. UMAP distances are not quantitative lineage distances. Recompute after meaningful subsetting.
alternatives: Leiden or other Seurat algorithms after validation; Harmony embedding for batch-corrected geometry.

purpose: Write reviewed level 1/2/3 annotations while preserving cluster IDs and evidence.
inputs: Seurat metadata with clusters; explicit cluster-to-label mappings by level plus evidence string.
outputs: labeled object; unmapped clusters remain Unknown
limits: Demo labels validate writeback only. Tissue markers, negative markers and subset reclustering require biological review. Cycling is a state, not a lineage.
alternatives: SingleR, Azimuth/reference mapping with suitable validated references; retain manual evidence.

purpose: Find exploratory cell/cluster markers without claiming donor-level treatment inference.
inputs: Normalized RNA Seurat with grouping labels.
limits: Cell-level P values can reflect pseudoreplication. Marker evidence does not by itself identify a cell type or treatment effect.
alternatives: Sample × cell-type pseudobulk with DESeq2/edgeR/limma for condition effects.

purpose: Sum raw counts per biological sample and cell type.
inputs: Raw RNA Seurat plus sample and cell-type identifiers.
limits: Summation is not a DEG test. Retain condition/covariate sample table, sufficient independent donors and within-subject design where needed.
alternatives: DESeq2/edgeR/limma-voom for sample-level testing; mixed models for justified cell-level designs.

purpose: Infer and visualize expression-supported ligand–receptor communication hypotheses.
inputs: list(expression: aligned log-normalized RNA, metadata: cell labels); human or mouse DB.
outputs: LR probabilities and native permutation P values
limits: Inference is not physical contact, causal signaling or donor-level inference. population.size depends on capture/sorting design. PPI projection is an optional information projection step.
alternatives: NicheNet for ligand → target response; CellPhoneDB/LIANA for complementary LR evidence.

purpose: Compare matched cell-type communication networks across two conditions.
inputs: Named list of two independently inferred CellChat objects with identical ordered cell labels, species, DB and settings.
limits: Second minus first direction is explicit. Missing significant pairs are encoded as zero only for descriptive deltas; this does not prove absent expression or FDR-controlled differential signaling.
alternatives: Official liftCellChat workflow for differing compositions; donor-stratified inference before population claims.

purpose: Learn a principal graph and order expression states from justified roots.
inputs: list(counts, aligned cell_metadata, gene_metadata with gene_short_name); explicit root cell IDs.
limits: Pseudotime ≠ real biological time. Disconnected partitions need justified roots. A graph branch is a hypothesis, not proof of cell fate.
alternatives: Slingshot fits lineages through clusters; tradeSeq tests trends along supplied trajectories; RNA velocity uses splicing kinetics; CellRank estimates fate probabilities.

purpose: Find graph-associated genes and co-varying gene modules.
inputs: Ordered CDS; explicit branch-selected cells for optional branch exploration.
limits: Graph autocorrelation is not a formal between-branch contrast. Do not replace Monocle3 analysis with Monocle2 BEAM; use tradeSeq for supported lineage contrasts.
alternatives: tradeSeq for GAM-based lineage association/difference tests.

purpose: Test over-representation of selected genes against the actually tested universe.
inputs: list(genes, universe), matched IDs, species and database.
limits: The universe is tested/detectable genes, not the whole genome by habit. GO hierarchy yields dependent terms; report database version and mapping losses. KEGG access/licensing needs review.
alternatives: GSEA when a complete ranked test statistic is available; cell-level score for cell states.

purpose: Test ranked gene-set enrichment without an arbitrary DEG cutoff.
inputs: list(ranks: complete signed named statistic, pathways: gene-set list); unique compatible IDs.
limits: Rank by a meaningful signed statistic, not P alone or arbitrary PPI degree for transcriptional enrichment. Record ties and mapped coverage; NES comparisons need identical gene-set definitions.
alternatives: ORA for a justified selected list; clusterProfiler GSEA for its result/visualization interface.

purpose: Estimate Pearson/Spearman associations with explicit missingness and BH adjustment.
inputs: data.frame of numeric measurements on independent observational units.
outputs: r/rho, P, BH-adjusted P, n and exclusions
Pearson CI; Spearman CI unavailable in this baseline
limits: Correlation ≠ causation. Pearson evaluates linear association; Spearman evaluates monotonic rank association. Repeated or confounded observations need another model.
alternatives: Partial/regression models for covariates; mixed models for repeated measurements.

purpose: Estimate right-censored survival curves and uncertainty by explicit group.
inputs: data.frame with nonnegative time, event explicitly coded 0/1 and group.
outputs: survival, 95% CI, risk counts and event table
limits: Requires appropriately independent censoring and correct time origin. KM does not adjust covariates; competing risks require cumulative-incidence methods.
alternatives: Cox for covariates; competing-risk analysis for competing events.

purpose: Estimate adjusted/unadjusted hazard ratios and inspect proportional hazards.
inputs: Complete observation table, explicit time/event and covariates.

parameters.covariates: one for univariate; several justified covariates for multivariate

limits: Specify continuous-effect forms and coding; assess PH, events, influential observations and confounding. Predictive claims require independent validation.
alternatives: Time-varying effects or alternative survival models when PH fails.

purpose: Estimate ambient contamination using raw droplets and cluster structure.
inputs: Raw and filtered count matrices, cluster labels.
limits: Requires informative ambient profile; validate retained biological expression.
alternatives: DecontX

purpose: Fit lineage curves through a cluster scaffold.
inputs: Embedding, cluster labels, justified starting cluster.
limits: Topology depends on clustering and starting assumptions.
alternatives: Monocle3; tradeSeq downstream

purpose: Test lineage-associated expression trends and differences.
inputs: Counts plus trajectory pseudotime and cell weights.
limits: Uses a supplied trajectory; it does not infer lineage by itself.
alternatives: Monocle3 graph association

purpose: Prioritize sender ligands that explain receiver transcriptional response.
inputs: Sender/receiver expression, receiver DEG, background expressed genes, prior networks.

parameters.review_required: Receiver gene set/background; expression threshold; prior species.

limits: Prior model and receiver contrast matter; ligand activity is predictive evidence, not causal proof.
alternatives: CellChat for LR network without target explanation

purpose: Test cell-label-dependent ligand–receptor coexpression.
inputs: Python expression matrix, metadata, database; approved orthology map for mouse.
limits: The legacy R LIANA MouseConsensus call is not execution of native Python CellPhoneDB.
alternatives: CellChat; LIANA

purpose: Compare/aggregate communication evidence with multiple methods.
inputs: AnnData or supported R interface, labels and compatible LR resource.
limits: Newness is not default eligibility; interface and resources need validation.
alternatives: CellChat; NicheNet

purpose: Estimate sample-level gene-set activity for replicated group comparisons.
inputs: Normalized gene × independent-sample matrix and gene sets.

parameters.review_required: GSVA vs ssGSEA; kernel; set sizes; installed API version.

limits: Recent GSVA uses parameter objects; never assume old gsva(expr, sets) API.
alternatives: GSEA for ranked group contrasts; UCell for cells

purpose: Score signatures per cell using rank-based enrichment.
inputs: Cell expression ranks/counts and specified signature gene sets.

parameters.review_required: Rank cutoff; gene coverage; signature direction.

limits: Cell scores describe state; group significance requires donor-aware aggregation/modeling.
alternatives: GSVA for sample-level activity

purpose: Analyze an actual protein-interaction graph and report network topology.
inputs: Species-specific mapped protein IDs and provenance-bearing STRING edges.

parameters.review_required: Species; STRING score; evidence channel; directedness.

limits: MCC requires a specified CytoHubba implementation; do not substitute degree. CellChat projection is a different operation.
alternatives: WGCNA for coexpression; SCENIC for regulons

purpose: Find coexpression modules across independent biological samples.
inputs: Normalized sample × gene matrix, QC and sample traits.

parameters.review_required: Soft threshold; signedness; minimum module size; covariates.

limits: Too few samples or pooled cells produce unstable/confounded modules.
alternatives: hdWGCNA for validated metacell designs

purpose: Build coexpression modules using explicitly defined single-cell aggregation.
inputs: Annotated Seurat, donor/celltype design and metacell choices.
limits: Metacells are not new independent biological replicates.
alternatives: WGCNA on sample-level profiles

purpose: Infer candidate transcription-factor regulons and activity.
inputs: Expression, species-compatible motif databases and TF annotations.

parameters.review_required: Network algorithm; motif resource; AUCell thresholds.

limits: Motif support and coexpression are not perturbation-validated regulation.
alternatives: pySCENIC in separate Python environment

purpose: Test replicated condition changes from raw bulk/pseudobulk counts.
inputs: Raw integer counts and aligned sample design/contrast.

parameters.review_required: Design formula; reference level; shrinkage; independent filtering.

limits: Do not input TPM/FPKM as counts; paired design and confounding require explicit handling.
alternatives: limma-voom; edgeR

purpose: Fit sample-level linear models with empirical-Bayes variance moderation.
inputs: Count matrix for voom or appropriate log expression, design and contrasts.
limits: Input scale determines workflow; technical batches cannot resolve complete design confounding.
alternatives: DESeq2; edgeR

purpose: Fit penalized regression with separated tuning and test assessment.
inputs: Training features/outcome, fixed sample-level folds, held-out validation.

parameters.review_required: Family; alpha=1; lambda.min vs lambda.1se; fold design.

limits: All filtering/scaling/selection must occur inside training folds.
alternatives: Elastic net; prespecified simpler models

purpose: Fit a penalized survival model with censor-aware validation.
inputs: Features and Surv outcome plus patient-level folds.

parameters.review_required: Lambda selection; event balance; censoring-aware metrics.

limits: Do not select genes globally before CV or claim causality from selected features.
alternatives: Cox; elastic-net Cox

purpose: Predict outcomes with a baseline ensemble and held-out performance.
inputs: Sample-level features/outcome and leakage-free train/test split.
limits: OOB does not replace independent external validation; importance is not mechanism.
alternatives: ranger; regularized logistic regression

purpose: Assess discrimination from held-out binary or time-to-event predictions.
inputs: Held-out outcomes/scores; event times and censoring for time-dependent ROC.

parameters.review_required: Positive class; score direction; horizons; IPCW estimator.

limits: Conventional ROC is inappropriate for censored survival outcomes; horizon and calibration also matter.
alternatives: PR curve for severe imbalance; calibration curves

purpose: Test replicated abundance shifts while considering composition.
inputs: Counts/neighbor graph and biological-sample design.
limits: Sample size, capture bias and composition affect inference; barplots alone are descriptive.
alternatives: Sample-level compositional models

purpose: Estimate kinetic expression-state direction from spliced/unspliced RNA.
inputs: AnnData with spliced/unspliced layers, preprocessing/QC.
limits: Velocity is not automatically causal lineage evidence; splicing data are mandatory.
alternatives: Monocle3/Slingshot when only expression states are available

purpose: Estimate state-transition and fate probabilities using explicit kernels.
inputs: AnnData, kernel and justified terminal-state definitions.
limits: Transition-kernel assumptions and terminal choices dominate interpretation.
alternatives: Trajectory ordering or velocity for different questions

purpose: Provide an independently managed Python route for core scRNA analysis.
inputs: AnnData counts, metadata and environment specification.
limits: R is the primary route; no shared giant Python environment is imposed.
alternatives: Seurat

purpose: Evaluate pretrained representation transfer against simple baselines.
inputs: Model-compatible expression tokens, checkpoints, training-domain audit.
outputs: Embeddings or task predictions with baseline comparison.
limits: Experimental until domain shift, leakage and baseline benefit are audited; no default checkpoint.
alternatives: PCA; validated integration/reference methods
